title: Run Ollama across the cluster
intro: Ollama runs on each chosen node behind one service. Every node keeps its own copy of each model, so models must fit on the smallest node.
success: Ollama is running. Download a model next (AI workloads > Download a model).

steps.label: Skip nodes with less memory than (GiB, 0 = use every node)
Also make the API reachable from your network (not just inside the cluster)?
